name: Source v1
about: Our own hall and rig in the spirit of Qlimax 2014 'The Source Code of Creation' (no Q-dance logo, star prop or figure replica). v1 (2026-10-25) adds the halo: 48 beam heads and 12 lasers on the rims of the circular array, grouped by altitude into a top, middle and bottom third that shoot out over the crowd; the vertical elements (pods under the PA hangs, the side towers, the delay towers out over the crowd); a 24-head lip row; laser groups; the ring-effect library; and phrases, starting with Daniel's: the thirds one per beat, the horizontal flash and pan, verticals 1-2-3, back to the lasers, then a pattern from the halo.
frame: origin floor at stage-lip centre; +x house right, +y up, +z over the crowd

beam-7r.label: narrow beam head (Sharpy class), generic personality
beam-7r.estimate: generic class personality written from published class specifications; travel times estimated

strand_shapes._about: kinetics wave A (2026-10-27): the strand's new shapes, outside the show's formations (the demo plays as it did). Real-mode honest, landed on the S-curve with cruise (a 12 m height change: 16 bars, the quintic's 28). ?strand=arch (or valley, ramp, stairs, helix-sine) lands one; the camera's views are keyed by their kinetics names.

helix-sine.name: wave
helix-sine.about: the honest real helix: a roll sine travelling down the strand; fitted to the hoists it turns +-50 degrees only over a measure of about 104 beats (at 32 beats it fits to +-13.7)

ring_rig.about: kinetics wave A (2026-10-27): the one source of the rings' motion numbers (kinetics.js ringAxisLimits). Each ring is 3-point hung on hoists at its outer rim, so a tilt moves the pickups r x dtilt: R0 (r 14) tilts at 0.5 / 14 rad/s = 2.0 deg/s, R3 (r 3) at 9.5. It lifts (y, up to 4.5 m) before it tilts and lowers after; every tilt is clamped into its legal window at its height (rig.js ringTiltWindow: R0 at 14 m only between about 47 and 63 degrees, the deck below, the back wall behind). Dream x3, and the dream-only rotators (yaw, spin) and axial travel.

ring_formations._about: formations.js. The Qlimax rings re-arranged: MORPH (pad 8, key 8) steps the deck on the next bar line, HERO (pad 9, key 9) fires the energy beam's discharge once per charge_bars, on the next ONE. home keeps the 2014 rule (the ring is still, the looks own its light); dream formations turn their rings on continuous rotators (prime beats per turn: each beat-locked, the set never repeats). Ring and palette numbers from the orrery report's measurements (radii stepping about x1.35 from the core, 5-7 thin bands, an orbit turning once in 4-5 s, a funnel whose rings step about 0.7). Roles are the theme's: ?theme=dreaming-city is the palette these were drawn for.

column.about: the energy beam: a narrow column from the floor upstage of the deck (where the rings' axis meets it, about (0, 0, -20.8)) up through the core to the roof

dreaming-city.name: Dreaming City
dreaming-city.about: Looks wave 1: the VJ library's Dreaming City (arsenal/web/vj-themes.json), measured from Daniel's stills: A the violet core, B the pink-violet haze, W and the first laser the cyan-white glyph lines, warm the window amber (the accent), the air the haze's deep violet. ?theme=dreaming-city

genesis-indigo.name: Genesis Indigo
genesis-indigo.about: Looks wave 1 (L01 Genesis, L02 Single Thread): one indigo hue in three values, white cores. ?theme=genesis-indigo

vex-conflux.name: Vex Conflux
vex-conflux.about: Looks wave 1 (L38; inspiration only): glyph cyan and milk white, brass for the warm role. The optic's red pin stays on the VJ page, where it is held; the Stage refuses red roles. ?theme=vex-conflux

anti-sun.name: Anti-Sun
anti-sun.about: Looks wave 1 (L34): zero chroma, white on black; with Single Thread or Pillars it is the anti-climax register. ?theme=anti-sun

formation_views._about: v2: the move shows the motion, the cut reveals the arrival. When a formation lands (the set's formation key, a ring formation's key, else its kinetics name), the director plays one glide from the next bar line (between half and twice the glide's own bars) and cuts ON the landing bar line to a hero view; each landing deals the next shot of each list, and a shot that would come within 1.5 m of the strand (or of the rings a ring formation sweeps) is skipped. The ring formations (formations.js): orrery, spiral, vortex, crown, portal.

corona.about: radially out from the ring centre, tipped 25 degrees toward the crowd

halo-levels.name: Halo Levels
halo-levels.about: Daniel, 2026-10-25: 'you can have top, midle then bottom pan up and down sequentially. or horizontal flash and pan, then vertical 1, 2, 3 then back to lasers, then a cool pattern of lights from the circular halo.' The levels are the altitude thirds of the circular array, one step per beat; his second pattern is top and bottom, middle, top and bottom again.

single-thread.name: Single Thread
single-thread.about: Looks wave 1, L02 (research/reviewed/keylab-liberation-2026-10-22/vj-v2-research-2026-10-27/looks.research.md): one beam from the hero at monumental length in a dark room. Scale comes from length and darkness, not fixture count (Henke's three white lasers, Tribute in Light), and the reset lets the next look land brighter without spending a flash. A reset after an anti-climax or the last breath before a final build; no beat lock. ?phrase=single-thread, then pad 3.

pillars.name: Pillars
pillars.about: Looks wave 1, L04 (Twin Pillars; the looks lane asks the UI to say Pillars): the delay towers' square clusters straight up, two columns 24 m apart over the crowd, still, everything else dark. Verticality, stillness and parallel symmetry make a monument inside a show that is otherwise always moving; the side towers join for the second half. Once per set, at a break's peak, released with a 2-beat fade. Pre-roll the haze (F5) two phrases ahead so the columns read to the roof. ?phrase=pillars, then pad 3.

scissor-gates.name: Scissor Gates
scissor-gates.about: Looks wave 1, L24: the measured Qlimax push-pull as a mechanical gesture. The tower lasers and Bank A cross into an X that flips every half beat, two colours swapping sides, so the room breathes with the reverse bass; then the gates open into fans for a bar. Lasers only, heads dark, the room at 0.1. ?phrase=scissor-gates, then pad 3.

tunnel-spokes.name: Tunnel Spokes
tunnel-spokes.about: Looks wave 1, L26: a tunnel of beams turning round the hero while the rings' spiral turns the same way, one direction per repeat; the direction changes only through the black beat that ends each repeat. Radial symmetry, rotation and depth are hypnotic. ?phrase=tunnel-spokes, then pad 3.

drumroll-iris.name: Drumroll Iris
drumroll-iris.about: Looks wave 1, L13: the last 8 bars of a build. The rings' chop halves its period every 2 bars (a bar, half a bar, a beat, half a beat: Solberg's drum roll, acceleration without a tempo change) while its lit arc narrows -- less light, more tension -- and the last beat is black, so the drop reopens all 360 degrees at once. One direction per repeat. ?phrase=drumroll-iris, then pad 3.
